Scripts.OnLoad:
self.Border:SetAtlas("honorsystem-bar-rewardborder-circle", Const.TextureKit.IgnoreAtlasSize)
local rewardType = self:GetAttribute("rewardType") if rewardType == "honor" then local faction = strlower(UnitFactionGroup("player")) self.Icon:SetAtlas("pvpqueue-sidebar-honorbar-badge-"..faction) self.IconBG:SetAtlas("pvpqueue-sidebar-honorbar-background-"..faction) self.IconBG:Show()
elseif rewardType =="arena" then self.Icon:SetTexture("Interface\\PVPFrame\\PVP-ArenaPoints-Icon") end

Scripts.OnEnter:
if not self.itemId and not self.winXP and not self.winHonor and not self.winArenaPoints then return end
GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") if self.itemId then GameTooltip:SetHyperlink("item:"..self.itemId) end
if self.winXP and self.winXP > 0 then GameTooltip:AddLine(EXPERIENCE, 1, 1, 1) GameTooltip:AddLine(" ") if self.lossXP and self.lossXP > 0 then GameTooltip:AddLine(PVP_REWARD_TOOLTIP, ni, nil, nil, false) GameTooltip:AddLine(format(PVP_REWARD_XP_FORMAT, self.lossXP), 1, 1, 1, false) GameTooltip:AddLine(" ") end GameTooltip:AddLine(PVP_REWARD_WIN_TOOLTIP, ni, nil, nil, false) GameTooltip:AddLine(format(PVP_REWARD_XP_FORMAT, self.winXP - (self.lossXP or 0)), 0.2, 1, 0, false) end
if self.winHonor and self.winHonor > 0 then GameTooltip:AddLine(HONOR_POINTS, 1, 1, 1) GameTooltip:AddLine(" ") if self.lossHonor and self.lossHonor > 0 then GameTooltip:AddLine(PVP_REWARD_TOOLTIP, ni, nil, nil, false) GameTooltip:AddLine(format(MERCHANT_HONOR_POINTS, self.lossHonor), 1, 1, 1, false) GameTooltip:AddLine(" ") end GameTooltip:AddLine(PVP_REWARD_WIN_TOOLTIP, ni, nil, nil, false) GameTooltip:AddLine(format(MERCHANT_HONOR_POINTS, self.winHonor - (self.lossHonor or 0)), 0.2, 1, 0, false) end
if self.winArenaPoints and self.winArenaPoints > 0 then GameTooltip:AddLine(ARENA_POINTS, 1, 1, 1) GameTooltip:AddLine(" ") if self.lossArenaPoints and self.lossArenaPoints > 0 then GameTooltip:AddLine(PVP_REWARD_TOOLTIP, ni, nil, nil, false) GameTooltip:AddLine(format(MERCHANT_ARENA_POINTS, self.lossArenaPoints), 1, 1, 1, false) GameTooltip:AddLine(" ") end GameTooltip:AddLine(PVP_REWARD_WIN_TOOLTIP, ni, nil, nil, false) GameTooltip:AddLine(format(MERCHANT_ARENA_POINTS, self.winArenaPoints - (self.lossArenaPoints or 0)), 0.2, 1, 0, false) end
GameTooltip:Show()

Scripts.OnLoad: Mixin(self, "PVPCasualActivityButtonMixin") self.NormalTexture:SetAtlas("pvpqueue-button-casual-up", Const.TextureKit.IgnoreAtlasSize) self.PushedTexture:SetAtlas("pvpqueue-button-casual-down", Const.TextureKit.IgnoreAtlasSize) self.HighlightTexture:SetAtlas("pvpqueue-button-casual-highlight", Const.TextureKit.IgnoreAtlasSize) self.SelectedTexture:SetAtlas("pvpqueue-button-casual-selected", Const.TextureKit.IgnoreAtlasSize) self.FrenzyTexture:SetAtlas("pvpqueue-button-casual-selected", Const.TextureKit.IgnoreAtlasSize) self.FrenzyTexture:SetVertexColor(1, 0.5, 0)

Mixin(self, "PVPRatedActivityButtonMixin") self.bgIndex = self:GetID() self.TeamSizeText:SetText(RATED_SIZE_STRINGS[self.bgIndex]) self.TeamTypeText:SetText(RATED_TYPE_STRINGS[self.bgIndex])
self:SetNormalAtlas("pvpqueue-button-up") self:SetPushedAtlas("pvpqueue-button-down") self:SetHighlightAtlas("pvpqueue-button-highlight")
self.SelectedTexture:SetAtlas("pvpqueue-button-selected", Const.TextureKit.IgnoreAtlasSize) self.FrenzyTexture:SetAtlas("pvpqueue-button-selected", Const.TextureKit.IgnoreAtlasSize) self.FrenzyTexture:SetVertexColor(1, 0.5, 0)

Scripts.OnEnter: if self.tooltip then GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") for i, text in ipairs(self.tooltip) do if i == 1 then GameTooltip:AddLine(text, 1, 1, 1, true) else GameTooltip:AddLine(text, nil, nil, nil, true) end end GameTooltip:Show() end

Scripts.OnShow: -- For a single frame this frame won't have the correct size Timer.After(0.01, function() self:GetParent():Update() end)

Scripts.OnClick: if self:IsEnabled() == 1 then local button = self:GetParent().selectedButton if button then if C_Player:IsHero() and not C_PrimaryStat:GetActivePrimaryStat() then ShowForcedPrimaryStat() return end PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") JoinBattlefield(button.bgIndex, 1) end end
Scripts.OnEnter: if self.tooltip then GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetText(self.tooltip, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.r, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.g, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.b, 1, true) GameTooltip:Show() end

Scripts.OnClick: if self:IsEnabled() == 1 then local button = self:GetParent().selectedButton if button then if C_Player:IsHero() and not C_PrimaryStat:GetActivePrimaryStat() then ShowForcedPrimaryStat() return end PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") if button.bgIndex == 1 and button.teamSize == 2 then C_Quest:SendPathToAscensionEvent("ACTION_QUEUE_FOR_2V2_SOLO_ARENA") end JoinBattlefield(button.bgIndex) end end

Scripts.OnClick: if self:IsEnabled() == 1 then local button = self:GetParent().selectedButton if button then if C_Player:IsHero() and not C_PrimaryStat:GetActivePrimaryStat() then ShowForcedPrimaryStat() return end local arenaIndex = button.bgIndex == 3 and 5 or (button.bgIndex + 1) PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") if button.bgIndex == 1 and button.teamSize == 2 then C_Quest:SendPathToAscensionEvent("ACTION_QUEUE_FOR_2V2_SOLO_ARENA") end if button.teamSize ~= 1 and C_CVar.GetNumber("pvpRole") == 0 then StaticPopupSpecial_Show(PvPRoleCheckPopup) PvPRoleCheckPopup.arenaIndex = arenaIndex return end JoinArenaWithRole(arenaIndex, C_CVar.GetNumber("pvpRole")) end end

Scripts.OnLoad: self:GetNormalTexture():SetAtlas("ui-lfg-roleicon-healer-micro", Const.TextureKit.IgnoreAtlasSize) SetParentArray(self, "RoleButtons") self.checkButton.onClick = function() C_CVar.Set("pvpRole", self.checkButton:GetBoolValue() and Enum.LFGRoles.Healer or 0) for i, button in ipairs(self:GetParent().RoleButtons) do if button ~= self then button.checkButton:SetChecked(false) end end end

self:GetNormalTexture():SetAtlas("ui-lfg-roleicon-dps-micro", Const.TextureKit.IgnoreAtlasSize) SetParentArray(self, "RoleButtons") self.checkButton.onClick = function() C_CVar.Set("pvpRole", self.checkButton:GetBoolValue() and Enum.LFGRoles.Damager or 0) for i, button in ipairs(self:GetParent().RoleButtons) do if button ~= self then button.checkButton:SetChecked(false) end end end

Scripts.OnEnter: if self.nextRank then GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_BOTTOM") GameTooltip:SetText(TOOLTIP_HONOR_LEVEL_NEXT_LEVEL) GameTooltip:AddLine(self.nextRank.." "..GLORY, 1, 1, 1) GameTooltip:Show() end

-- today local todayHK, todayHonor = GetPVPSessionStats()
-- yesterday local yesterdayHK, yesterdayHonor = GetPVPYesterdayStats() GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetText(HONORABLE_KILLS) GameTooltip:AddLine(HONOR_TODAY..": "..todayHK, 1, 1, 1) GameTooltip:AddLine(HONOR_YESTERDAY..": "..yesterdayHK, 1, 1, 1) GameTooltip:AddLine(" ") GameTooltip:AddLine(HONOR_GAINED) GameTooltip:AddLine(HONOR_TODAY..": "..todayHonor, 1, 1, 1) GameTooltip:AddLine(HONOR_YESTERDAY..": "..yesterdayHonor, 1, 1, 1) GameTooltip:Show()

if self.name and self.rating then GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetText(format(TOOLTIP_PVP_NEXT_RANK, self.name)) GameTooltip:AddLine(format(PVP_NEXT_RANK_DESC, (self.rating - 1)), 1, 1, 1, false) GameTooltip:Show() end

Scripts.OnShow:
local best, arenaType, index = C_PVP:GetCurrentBestRating() local name, _, _, _, nextTier, icon = C_PVP:GetPVPTierInfo(best)
self.Title:SetText(arenaType)
self:SetID(index) self:Update()
if nextTier then local nextName, _, _, _, _, nextIcon = C_PVP:GetPVPTierInfo(nextTier) self.NextTier.Icon:SetTexture(nextIcon)
self.NextTier.name = nextName self.NextTier.rating = nextTier
self.NextTier:Show() else self.NextTier.name = nil self.NextTier.rating = nil self.NextTier:Hide() end
